summary_ja: 保証による信用リスク削減効果を勘案する場合の明確な基準の性質を定める。
summary_en: Requires clear standards for adjustment for guarantees that are credible, reflect guarantor capacity and correlation, and account for residual risk.
paragraphs: Where the credit risk mitigation effect is taken into account under paragraph (1) or (2) of Article 197, an Ultimate Designated Parent Company adopting the internal ratings-based approach shall establish clear standards that satisfy all of the following characteristics: (i) they are credible and easy to understand; (ii) they take into account the guarantor's ability and willingness to perform the guaranteed obligation; (iii) they take into account the expected timing of payment and the extent to which the guarantor's ability to perform the guaranteed obligation is correlated with the obligor's repayment capacity; (iv) they take into account the degree of risk remaining with the obligor due to currency mismatch between the guarantee and the guaranteed claim and other similar causes.
